area.canggu.name: Canggu

area.nusa-dua.description: Planned, serviced and regulated — the one part of Bali built to a masterplan. Permits are predictable, utilities are real, and the guest mix skews corporate and conference.
area.nusa-dua.name: Nusa Dua
area.nusa-dua.subtitle: Badung · Southern enclave
area.pererenan.description: Rice fields, a river mouth and a slower street grid. Pererenan absorbs the overflow from Canggu at a lower land cost, and plots here still come with a view worth designing around.
area.pererenan.name: Pererenan
area.pererenan.subtitle: Badung · North of Canggu
area.pererenan.tagline: Canggu demand, with room left to build.
area.sanur.description: A reef-protected shoreline, a flat beach path and the new international hospital district. Sanur rents to a repeat, longer-staying market that barely notices low season.

area.sanur.subtitle: Denpasar · East coast

area.seminyak.description: The original premium strip: beach clubs, restaurants and a guest profile that pays for location rather than novelty. Little new land, so value sits in renovation and boutique density.

area.seminyak.subtitle: Badung · Central beach strip
area.tabanan.description: Black-sand coastline past Tanah Lot, with the new coastal road shortening the drive every year. Entry cost is a third of Canggu — this is a land-banking play with a build option.

area.tabanan.subtitle: Tabanan · North-west coast

faq1.answer: Yes — through leasehold (Hak Sewa), or through an Indonesian company (PT PMA) holding a right-to-build title (HGB). Freehold stays with Indonesian nationals, so we structure every project one of those two ways, and the notary walks you through the difference before you sign anything.
faq1.question: Can a foreigner own property in Bali?
faq2.answer: A lease is a contract for a fixed number of years — typically 25 or 30, with an extension period agreed and pre-paid at the start. At expiry the land returns to the owner unless the extension is exercised or a new term is negotiated. We register the extension option notarially on day one, so your right to extend is on the public record from the start.
faq2.question: What actually happens when the lease expires?
faq3.answer: Between roughly $650 and $1,100 per m² of built area for the quality level we work at, excluding land, pool, landscaping and furniture. The range is wide because site access, retaining works and water supply vary enormously between Canggu and the Bukit. We price a bill of quantities per project rather than quoting a rate.
faq3.question: How much does it cost to build, per square metre?
faq4.answer: Twelve to eighteen months on site for a typical three-bedroom villa, plus two to four months beforehand for permits. Add land sourcing and due diligence and a realistic end-to-end figure is twenty to twenty-four months from first conversation to first guest.
faq4.question: How long does a villa take?
faq5.answer: What we can stand behind is where the numbers come from. Every figure on this site is underwritten from our own operating data on delivered properties in the same area, and we will show you the statements behind it. They are projections rather than guarantees — occupancy, rates and regulation all move — so treat them as a well-evidenced range.
faq5.question: Are the projected yields guaranteed?
faq6.answer: That is entirely your choice. Most owners stay with us because it is the same team that built the property and they already know where every valve and cable is. The construction contract and the management agreement are separate documents, so you are free to sign one without the other.

insight.a-week-in-your-own-bali-villa.bo: You land in the evening, and someone you know is at the airport. The fridge has what you asked for. The pool is the temperature it always is. By the second morning you have stopped checking your phone before breakfast.

None of that is a return, and we would not try to put a number on it. But it is the reason most owners we work with started looking in the first place, and it is why we design around how someone wants to live before we design around what the property should earn.
The investment case has to stand up on its own. This part is what makes people keep the villa once it does.
insight.a-week-in-your-own-bali-villa.ex: The part that does not appear in any spreadsheet, and the reason most owners started looking.
insight.a-week-in-your-own-bali-villa.ti: A Week in Your Own Bali Villa: The Lifestyle Value of Ownership
insight.gross-yield-vs-net-return.body1: Gross rental yield is annual rental revenue divided by what the property cost. It is a useful comparison metric precisely because it is crude — it ignores everything that happens between a guest paying and money reaching you.
insight.gross-yield-vs-net-return.body2: Between those two points sit channel commissions, management fees, housekeeping, laundry, utilities, pool and garden, repairs, a sinking fund for replacement, taxes and the cost of the nights nobody booked. Depending on the property and the operating model, they can account for a third to a half of gross revenue.
insight.gross-yield-vs-net-return.body3: So a gross figure is not wrong, it is just incomplete. When you are given one, the question to ask is simply: what does this become after costs, and which costs are in your list? A developer who can answer that quickly, with their own numbers, is telling you something useful about how they operate.
insight.gross-yield-vs-net-return.excerp: Two numbers, frequently confused, often deliberately. What sits between them, and which one you should be asking for.
insight.gross-yield-vs-net-return.title: Understanding Gross Rental Yield vs Net Return
insight.how-to-read-a-villa-investment-m: Start at the top line. What nightly rate is assumed, and against which comparable properties? A model built on the best three villas in the area is not a model, it is an aspiration.
Then occupancy. Is it a year-round average, and does it account for low season? An 85% assumption is achievable in parts of Bali and fantasy in others.

Then the cost list. If it has fewer than six lines, something is missing. Housekeeping, laundry, utilities, pool and garden, repairs, replacement, channel fees, management, taxes — all of it belongs there, with a number beside it.
Finally, ask what the model does at 60% occupancy. Any projection worth trusting has been stress-tested downwards, and whoever built it should be able to show you that version without hesitating.
A short checklist for pulling apart any projection you are shown — including ours.
How to Read a Villa Investment Model: Revenue, Costs and Assumptions
insight.location-design-guest-experience: Location sets your ceiling. Design decides how much of that ceiling you reach. Guest experience decides whether you keep reaching it in year three.

The common failure is treating them in sequence — buy the land, then design something, then find someone to run it. Each decision then constrains the next one, usually badly: a plot with a beautiful view and a layout that faces away from it, or a villa that photographs well and takes four hours to turn around between guests.
Taken together at concept stage, the three reinforce each other, and the compromises become explicit choices rather than discoveries.
Why the three cannot be separated, and what happens to a property when one of them is treated as optional.
Location, Design and Guest Experience: The Three Drivers of Villa Demand
insight.owning-in-bali-introduction.body: Foreign nationals do not hold freehold title in Indonesia. Property is held through leasehold, or through an Indonesian company structure that carries a right-to-build title. Both are ordinary, both are used constantly, and both have details that reward attention.

The single most important one is what happens at the end of the term. A lease is a contract for a fixed number of years, usually with an extension agreed at the start. Whether that extension is registered notarially, and on what terms, is the difference between an asset and a promise.
None of this is a reason to be nervous. It is a reason to read the documents, use your own notary, and be suspicious of anyone who tells you it is simpler than it is.
insight.owning-in-bali-introduction.exce: Leasehold, right-to-build and company structures — in plain language, with the questions worth asking your notary.
insight.owning-in-bali-introduction.titl: Owning in Bali: A Practical Introduction for International Buyers
insight.personal-use-and-rental-income.b: Every week you keep for yourself is a week the villa is not earning. That is simply true, and any brochure that pretends otherwise is not worth reading. The interesting part is that the cost of those weeks is not constant — it depends entirely on which weeks you take.

Take the first two weeks of August and you are removing your highest-rate nights of the year. Take late October and the same fortnight costs a fraction of that. Owners who plan their own use around the shoulder season often find the difference between the two patterns is larger than any operational saving anyone can offer them.

Design helps too. An owner’s suite that can be locked and serviced separately lets the rest of the villa work while your things stay where you left them, which removes the practical friction that usually pushes owners towards using the property less than they intended.
insight.personal-use-and-rental-income.e: The trade-offs between blocking your own dates and keeping a calendar attractive to guests — and how design can soften them.
insight.personal-use-and-rental-income.t: How a Bali Villa Can Combine Personal Use and Rental Income
insight.short-term-vs-residential.body1: A long residential tenancy is a financial product: one contract, one payment a month, low workload, low upside. A short-term hospitality operation is a small business: many contracts, daily work, staff, consumables, reviews, and a materially higher gross.
insight.short-term-vs-residential.body2: Comparing their headline yields directly is misleading, because they are not the same measure of the same thing. The residential figure is close to net. The hospitality figure is a long way from it.
insight.short-term-vs-residential.body3: Which one suits you is a question about appetite and involvement, not about which number is bigger.
insight.short-term-vs-residential.excerp: Two different businesses that happen to involve the same building. Cost structure, risk and workload all differ.
insight.short-term-vs-residential.title: Short-Term Hospitality vs Traditional Residential Rental Models
insight.tailor-made-owner-goals.body1: Every owner has a different right villa, shaped by location, budget and what they want the property to do — and the gap between those versions is larger than most people expect.
insight.tailor-made-owner-goals.body2: An owner who will spend three months a year in the property wants storage, a kitchen that works for cooking rather than photographs, and a suite that can be closed off. An owner who will visit twice a year wants bedroom parity, fast turnaround and a layout that reads well in twelve photographs.
insight.tailor-made-owner-goals.body3: Both are legitimate. Building the second for the first owner is how people end up quietly disliking a property they spent two years making.
insight.tailor-made-owner-goals.excerpt: The same plot produces three different buildings depending on what the owner needs from it.
insight.tailor-made-owner-goals.title: Why Tailor-Made Villa Development Can Fit Different Owner Goals
insight.what-drives-villa-revenue.body1: Revenue is rate multiplied by occupancy, and the two move against each other. Drop your rate and you fill the calendar, but you may fill it with shorter stays that cost more to service. Hold your rate and you keep margin per night, but you carry more empty nights.
insight.what-drives-villa-revenue.body2: The properties that do well are rarely the cheapest or the most expensive in their street. They are the ones where the rate is set deliberately against a known guest — and where the operator adjusts it weekly rather than setting it once at launch.
insight.what-drives-villa-revenue.body3: The third variable, length of stay, is the one most owners never look at. Two seven-night bookings and seven two-night bookings can produce the same occupancy and completely different margins.
insight.what-drives-villa-revenue.excerp: Rate, occupancy and length of stay pull against each other. Understanding how is most of the job.
insight.what-drives-villa-revenue.title: What Drives Villa Revenue in Bali?
insight.why-bali-lifestyle-tourism-prope: Bali received 6,948,754 direct foreign tourist arrivals in 2025, an increase of 9.72% on 2024. That single figure is the reason most people start looking at property here, but on its own it explains very little. What matters to an owner is not how many people land at the airport — it is how long they stay, what they book, and where.

A guest staying nine nights in Ubud and a guest staying two nights in Kuta contribute to the same arrivals number and behave completely differently as revenue. Length of stay changes your cleaning cost per night, your channel mix, your cancellation profile and how exposed you are to low season.

The useful question is therefore narrower than "is Bali growing?". It is: which part of this demand does my villa actually serve, and is the property designed for that guest? That question is answerable at design stage, and very expensive to answer after handover.
What actually sits underneath the island’s property market — arrivals, length of stay, and why the two matter differently to an owner.
Why Bali: The Lifestyle, Tourism and Property Story

process.method.gross.text: Gross rental yield is annual rental revenue divided by total investment, before operating expenses, taxes, management, maintenance, utilities and platform fees. It is a comparison metric, not money in your account.
process.method.gross.title: What gross yield covers
process.method.net.text: We model a {fee}% management and channel fee and roughly {opex}% operating cost — staff, utilities, pool and garden, consumables, repairs and a sinking fund. Both figures appear side by side on every project page.
process.method.net.title: How we get from gross to net
process.method.returns.text: Every number here is a projection with its assumptions on show, which is why we publish an evidenced range rather than a guaranteed return or a fixed income. Occupancy, nightly rates, regulation and taxation all move, and you are welcome to challenge any assumption we have made.
process.method.returns.title: How we talk about returns
process.method.revenue.text: A nightly rate taken from comparable properties in the same area and bedroom count — not from the three best-performing villas on the island — multiplied by an occupancy assumption we can evidence from our own managed portfolio.
process.method.revenue.title: Where the revenue assumption comes from
process.principle.afterHandover.text: The team that designed and built your villa is the team that runs it, so the same people stay accountable for how it performs.
process.principle.afterHandover.title: With you after handover
process.principle.numbers.text: Every projection comes with its assumptions written down — the rate, the occupancy, the percentages — so you can follow the reasoning and test it against your own.
process.principle.numbers.title: Numbers you can check
process.principle.tailorMade.text: We start from what you want the property to do. The same plot produces a different building for a different owner, and that is the point.
process.principle.tailorMade.title: Tailor-made by default
process.principle.visible.text: Photographs from site every week and spend reconciled against the bill of quantities every month, so you always know exactly where your build stands.
process.principle.visible.title: Visible as it is built
process.role: Our role is to bring together the right people, knowledge and execution to help you make your Bali property as good as possible.
process.safeguard.cost.text: You sign a line-item bill of quantities rather than a rate per square metre. Our quantity surveyor reconciles spend against it monthly, so every variance is on the table in the month it happens.
process.safeguard.cost.title: Cost held to the quote
process.safeguard.earning.text: Listings, photography and pricing are prepared in the final eight weeks of construction, so the villa goes live within three weeks of handover rather than three months.
process.safeguard.earning.title: Earning from week one
process.safeguard.handover.text: The programme is contractual, with liquidated damages behind it. Ninety-six per cent of what we have delivered since 2016 landed on or before the contracted date.
process.safeguard.handover.title: Handover on the agreed date
process.safeguard.title.text: Every plot is checked at the land office against the certificate chain, and the banjar is consulted before an offer goes in. You see exactly what we found, and we move forward on land that is clean to lease.
process.safeguard.title.title: Title verified first
process.safeguards.lede: These four decide how a Bali project turns out, and each one has a specific answer built into the way we work. Ask us about any of them.
process.safeguards.title: Four things handled before you have to ask.
process.service.accounting.text: PB1 lodgement, company bookkeeping, annual filings and the paperwork your accountant at home will ask for.
process.service.accounting.title: Accounting and tax
process.service.listing.text: Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda and a direct site, behind one calendar. Photography and copy are produced before handover, not after.
process.service.listing.title: Listing and distribution
process.service.maintenance.text: Housekeeping, pool and garden, and a preventive schedule written by the people who built the property. Repairs at cost.
process.service.maintenance.title: Maintenance and upkeep
process.service.pricing.text: Rates move daily against occupancy, lead time, events and what comparable villas in the street are charging.
process.service.pricing.title: Dynamic pricing
process.service.reception.text: Check-in at three in the morning, a driver, a broken air-conditioner at midnight. Handled locally, in person.
process.service.reception.title: Guest reception, 24/7
process.service.reporting.text: One statement on the fifth of every month: what came in, what went out, what was transferred, and anything unusual.
process.service.reporting.title: Owner reporting
process.services.lede: The team that designed and built the villa is the team that runs it — which is why a blocked pump is a phone call rather than an investigation.
process.services.title: Handover is where the asset starts working.
process.statement.foot: Supplier invoices and the full booking ledger are attached every month.
process.statement.lede: A real statement shape, from a three-bedroom villa in Pererenan in a shoulder month. Twenty-nine nights let, one pool repair, and the balance transferred on the fifth.
process.statement.title: One page. Every line.
process.tailorMade: Every owner has a different right villa. We shape it around your location, your budget and what you want the property to do.
processStep1.description: We start from what you want the asset to do — yield, personal use, resale horizon — and work backwards to an area, a plot size and a realistic total cost.
processStep1.title: Brief and budget
processStep2.description: Our land scouts work the areas you shortlisted. Every candidate plot gets a legal pack before you see a price: certificate chain, zoning, access, water and banjar position.
processStep2.title: Land sourcing and due diligence
processStep3.description: Concept, then developed design, then a bill of quantities priced item by item. You sign off on a fixed BOQ — not a square-metre estimate that drifts.
processStep3.title: Design and costing
processStep4.description: PBG permit, then groundworks. Our own site team builds it: supervisors, quality control and a quantity surveyor reconciling spend against the BOQ every month.
processStep4.title: Permits and construction
processStep5.description: An independent snagging list, then defects cleared before you sign. Furniture, utilities and licences are in place on the day you receive the keys.
processStep5.title: Snagging and handover
processStep6.description: Our operations team takes over: listings, pricing, guests, staff, maintenance. One statement a month showing revenue, cost and what landed in your account.
processStep6.title: Operations and reporting
project.batu-loft-townhouses.body1: Land in Berawa no longer supports stand-alone villas at a sensible entry price. The townhouse format keeps your ticket under $250,000 and your nightly rate within $40 of a full villa — which is where the yield comes from.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.body2: Each loft has its own 4 × 3 m plunge pool, an outdoor shower and a covered parking bay. The shared rooftop is operated by the management company and generates a second revenue line from non-resident guests.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.body3: Delivery is the closest of any project we have open: the structure is complete and we are in second fix.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.headline: Eight two-bedroom lofts, five minutes from Berawa beach.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.name: Batu Loft Townhouses
project.batu-loft-townhouses.summary: A compact, high-turnover format for the Canggu market: two-storey lofts with a plunge pool each and a shared rooftop bar.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.timeline1.n: Eight footings poured; site office and staff facilities installed.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.timeline2.n: All eight units topped out; rooftop slab poured.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.timeline3.n: Electrical, plumbing and pool plant roughed in and pressure tested.
project.batu-loft-townhouses.timeline4.n: Joinery installed in units 1–5; pools filled and commissioned.
project.karang-nusa-villas.body1: Nusa Dua is the only masterplanned district on the island. Power, water, drainage and fibre arrive at the plot boundary, the road is maintained, and the permit path is measured in weeks rather than quarters.
project.karang-nusa-villas.body2: The guest profile is different from the west coast: corporate travel, conferences and families who want a pool without a scooter. Occupancy is steadier, and cancellations are rarer.
project.karang-nusa-villas.body3: Five villas, three bedrooms each, delivered turnkey with a furniture package specified for rental durability rather than showroom appeal.
project.karang-nusa-villas.headline: Five serviced villas inside the Nusa Dua enclave.
project.karang-nusa-villas.name: Karang Nusa Villas
project.karang-nusa-villas.summary: Gated, serviced and zoned — the lowest-friction permit environment in Bali, with resort-grade utilities already at the boundary.
project.karang-nusa-villas.timeline1.not: Thirty-year lease over 2,000 m² registered with the notary.
project.kayu-commercial-block.body1: Commercial leases in Canggu are signed two to five years in advance and paid annually up front. That changes the cash-flow shape of the asset completely — the retail bays alone cover the operating cost of the whole building.
project.kayu-commercial-block.body2: The studios above are let monthly to long-stay guests rather than nightly, which removes most of the housekeeping and channel cost. Blended, the block underwrites at 15.1% net.
project.kayu-commercial-block.body3: This is the format we recommend to investors who want yield without the operational drama of a nightly-rate villa.
project.kayu-commercial-block.headline: Ground-floor retail with six serviced studios above.
project.kayu-commercial-block.name: Kayu Commercial Block
project.kayu-commercial-block.summary: A mixed-use block on Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong: three retail bays at street level, six serviced studios on the two floors above.
Commercial zoning confirmed; PBG issued for three storeys.
Bored piles to 9 m; ground slab poured and cured.
project.ombak-residences.body1: Ombak sits on 1,400 m² of former rice field with a protected green belt on its northern edge — the view cannot be built out. Four villas share a private access road, a staff entrance and a single deep well, which keeps running costs per unit roughly 30% below a stand-alone build.
project.ombak-residences.body2: Each villa is laid out for rental first: bedrooms on the ground floor with direct pool access, living and kitchen upstairs where the ceiling opens to a 5-metre ridge. The layout photographs well, which matters more to your booking rate than any finish we could specify.
project.ombak-residences.body3: Construction is by our own site team under a fixed bill of quantities. You receive a photo set and a cost reconciliation every Friday until handover.
project.ombak-residences.headline: Four three-bedroom villas, one shared rice-field frontage.
project.ombak-residences.name: Ombak Residences
project.ombak-residences.summary: A small cluster of 3-bedroom villas set back from Jalan Pantai Pererenan, each with a 9-metre pool and an open-air upper living deck.
project.ombak-residences.timeline1.note: Due diligence closed, notarial lease signed for 25 + 25 years.
project.ombak-residences.timeline1.title: Land secured, PT PMA registered
project.ombak-residences.timeline2.note: Building permit approved for four units at 245 m² each.
project.ombak-residences.timeline2.title: IMB / PBG permit issued
project.ombak-residences.timeline3.note: All four slabs complete; pool shells waterproofed and tested.
project.ombak-residences.timeline3.title: Foundations and pool shells poured
project.ombak-residences.timeline4.note: Bengkirai ridge beams pre-ordered and stored on site.
project.ombak-residences.timeline4.title: Roof structure — scheduled
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.body1: Ubud rewards a different format. Guests stay five to nine nights, book earlier, and choose on atmosphere rather than proximity to a beach club. Sawah is built for that: individual pavilions for privacy, shared facilities for the operator’s margin.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.body2: The whole site can be let as a single retreat venue — which is what a wellness operator will pay a multi-year fixed lease for. That option is what turns a low-twelves projected yield into a floor rather than a forecast.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.body3: Structure is exposed bengkirai and local paras stone; roofs are alang-alang over a waterproof membrane, so you get the look without the five-year replacement cycle.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.headline: Six one-bedroom pavilions around a shared wellness deck.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.name: Sawah Ubud Retreat
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.summary: A retreat-format build in the Petulu valley: six private pavilions, a yoga shala and a 20-metre lap pool, designed to be operated as one property.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.timeline1.not: 1,100 m² in Petulu; river-boundary setback confirmed with the banjar.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.timeline2.not: PBG approved for six pavilions plus shared facilities.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.timeline3.not: All six pavilion frames erected; shala ring beam poured.
project.sawah-ubud-retreat.timeline4.not: Lap pool tiled and filled; paras stone paving 70% laid.
project.segara-beachfront-villas.body1: Beachfront leasehold in Sanur almost never reaches the open market. This plot came to us through a family we have worked with since 2019, and we are releasing it to our existing clients first.
project.segara-beachfront-villas.body2: Sanur’s guest profile is older, stays longer and books directly — which means lower channel fees and far less seasonality than the west coast. The trade-off is a lower nightly rate, and the model reflects that honestly.
project.segara-beachfront-villas.body3: Registration of interest opens now; we will not take a deposit before the notarial due diligence pack is in your hands.
project.segara-beachfront-villas.headlin: Two beachfront villas on the last unbuilt plot in north Sanur.
project.segara-beachfront-villas.name: Segara Beachfront Villas
project.segara-beachfront-villas.summary: Direct access to the reef-protected shoreline, with a 700 m² plot split into two four-bedroom villas.
project.segara-beachfront-villas.timelin: Exclusive option signed; legal due diligence commissioned.
project.sungai-house.body1: Sungai House is the property we point people to when they ask what actually happens after handover. It sits on a river plot in Pererenan with a protected green boundary, which is why the pool could run the full length of the site instead of being tucked beside the building.
project.sungai-house.body2: The layout is a hybrid brief: the owner uses it for roughly ten weeks a year, and it is let for the rest. The upper floor carries an owner’s suite that locks and is serviced separately, so personal belongings stay in place while the rest of the villa works.
project.sungai-house.body3: Everything on this page — the photographs, the walkthrough, the operating figures — comes from this building rather than from a render. Ask us for the twelve-month statement and we will send it.
project.sungai-house.headline: Our reference build: a three-bedroom villa on the river, delivered and operating.
project.sungai-house.name: Sungai House
project.sungai-house.summary: Two storeys over a 12-metre pool that runs along the river boundary, with a sunken lounge set into the deck. Delivered in 2025 and let since.
project.sungai-house.timeline1.note: Two storeys, 260 m², on a 420 m² river plot.
project.sungai-house.timeline1.title: Construction start
project.sungai-house.timeline2.note: Pool shell tested and tiled; ironwood deck laid over the full frontage.
project.sungai-house.timeline2.title: Pool and deck complete
project.sungai-house.timeline3.note: Snagging closed, furniture installed, photography and listing prepared before the keys.
project.sungai-house.timeline3.title: Handover
project.sungai-house.timeline4.note: First guests three weeks after handover; owner statements monthly since.
project.sungai-house.timeline4.title: Operations start
project.tebing-cliff-villas.body1: The plot sits on the second row back from the cliff path, which means no public access along your boundary and a building line that Badung planning has already approved. Engineering was the hard part: a 4.5-metre retaining structure tied into bedrock, designed by our in-house structural engineer and independently checked.
project.tebing-cliff-villas.body2: Nightly rates on this stretch of the Bukit are the highest we underwrite anywhere on the island. Occupancy is lower than Canggu, but the rate difference more than compensates — the net yield model assumes 74% and still clears 14%.
project.tebing-cliff-villas.body3: Water is trucked and stored in a 30 m³ reservoir under the driveway, with UV and reverse-osmosis treatment. This is the single most common failure point in Bukit villas, and it is engineered, not improvised.
project.tebing-cliff-villas.headline: Three cliff-edge villas, 120 metres above the Indian Ocean.
project.tebing-cliff-villas.name: Tebing Cliff Villas
project.tebing-cliff-villas.summary: Uninterrupted west-facing ocean views with an 11-metre infinity pool cantilevered over the limestone edge.
project.tebing-cliff-villas.timeline1.no: Certificate checked against Badung land office; zoning confirmed as tourism.
project.tebing-cliff-villas.timeline2.no: Bedrock at 2.1 m; retaining design finalised and externally verified.
project.tebing-cliff-villas.timeline3.no: PBG application lodged; approval expected within 10 weeks.

testimonial1.quote: I bought a plot I had only seen on video, from Istanbul. What made it work was the Friday photo set — twenty months of it. I never once had to ask where my money had gone.
testimonial2.author: Mark R.
testimonial2.quote: The bill of quantities was 340 lines long and I understood maybe half of it. Their QS went through it with me twice. Final cost came in 2.1% over the contract — and they had flagged every item before it happened.

testimonial3.quote: Handover was not the end of the relationship, which is what I had been warned about. The villa was listed three weeks later and I have had a statement on the fifth of every month since.

whyBali.heroLede: Bali is more than a destination. It is a lifestyle people return to — and the flow of people returning is what makes a villa here more than a holiday home.
whyBali.lead: Bali is more than a destination. It is a lifestyle people return to.
whyBali.para1: Millions of people come to Bali to experience the lifestyle. They spend on accommodation, food, wellness and experiences. That flow of visitors supports a large hospitality economy, and property owners can participate in that economy while still keeping the lifestyle value of their own villa.
whyBali.para2: We give you the opportunity to own a piece of the property side of that economy — without giving up the reason you wanted a place in Bali in the first place.

yield.footnote: *Indicative range, not a guarantee and not an offer. Net yield is stated after our management fee and operating costs, on total investment including the pre-paid land lease. Actual performance varies with occupancy, nightly rates, season, regulation and taxation. Every figure here is a projection you are entitled to challenge.
yield.headline: 14–20%* Indicative Net Rental Yield
yield.subline: After our 15% management fee and around 10% operating costs, on the total investment including the land lease. Where a project lands in the range depends more on how well the unit is designed than on how big it is.
living.title: The part that is not a spreadsheet.
living.lead: Almost nobody decides on the numbers alone. These are the questions that actually settle it — and Bali answers them better than most people expect before they arrive.
living.school.title: Schools
living.school.text: Green School in Sibang, Canggu Community School, Bali Island School in Sanur and Sunrise School cover IB and Cambridge curricula from kindergarten through to eighteen. Places fill a term ahead, which is worth knowing before you choose an area.
living.health.title: Healthcare
living.health.text: BIMC in Kuta and Nusa Dua and Siloam in Denpasar handle emergencies to international standards, with Singapore two and a half hours away for anything they cannot. Day-to-day, a good English-speaking GP visit costs less than a coffee in Europe.
living.sport.title: Sport
living.sport.text: Padel and tennis have arrived, the gyms in Canggu and Uluwatu are genuinely good, and there is surf, cycling, muay thai and more yoga than any one person could use. Most of it is outdoors, all year.
living.food.title: Food and shopping
living.food.text: Warungs at two dollars, restaurants that would hold their own anywhere, and Pepito, Frestive and Grand Lucky for a proper weekly shop including the European things you will miss. Delivery reaches almost everywhere.
living.family.title: Family
living.family.text: Playgrounds, swimming lessons, kids clubs and weekend sport are all normal here, and the international community is large enough that children arrive into a ready-made one. Domestic help is affordable in a way that changes how a family lives.
living.around.title: Getting around
living.around.text: Scooters for short runs, Grab and Gojek for everything else, and a driver for the day for less than a taxi across a European city. The airport is thirty-five to seventy-five minutes from the areas we build in.
living.note: Schools, clinics and clubs change. We keep a current list and go through it with you against the areas you are considering, because the right area for a family is rarely the right area for a couple.
craft.title: What a Bali villa is made of.
craft.lead: Four things decide whether a villa feels like Bali or like a house that happens to be here. All four are ours to get right, and all four are done locally.
craft.architecture.title: Architecture
craft.architecture.text: Modern tropical, Javanese joglo, Mediterranean, brutalist in stone — the style is yours. What does not change is the Balinese logic underneath it: open-air living, a roof that breathes, deep shade, water in the plan, and a building that faces the way the light and the wind actually come. That logic is why a Bali villa photographs and lives the way it does, and it survives any style you put on top of it.
craft.interiors.title: Interiors and furniture
craft.interiors.text: Indonesia is one of the world’s furniture workshops — Jepara for carved teak, Bali for rattan, stone and terrazzo — and it is on your doorstep. Pieces are made for your villa rather than ordered from a catalogue, at a price that would buy something mass-produced in Europe. We specify for rental durability as well as for the photograph, because the two are not the same thing.
craft.landscape.title: Landscaping
craft.landscape.text: A Balinese landscaper will turn a flat, empty plot into jungle, or into a rice-field edge, or into something that feels like it has always been on a beach — in eighteen months, because everything grows here. This is the cheapest privacy you will ever buy: planting does what a wall cannot, and it is the difference between a villa on a road and a villa in its own world.
craft.hospitality.title: Hospitality
craft.hospitality.text: Indonesian hospitality is the reason guests rebook, and it is not something we have to teach. A breakfast worth waking up for, a garden kept daily, a butler if you want one, a private chef for the nights you do not want to go out — all of it at a cost structure that makes it normal rather than exceptional. Reviews follow service, and rates follow reviews.
zoning.title: The rules got clearer. That is good news for you.
zoning.lead: Indonesia spent 2025 and 2026 putting property licensing onto one verifiable trail, and Bali added a provincial rule of its own. A plot that clears all of it is now worth demonstrably more than one that does not — and finding out which is which is the first thing we do.
zoning.zone.title: Zone first, price second
zoning.zone.text: Bali Provincial Regulation No. 4 of 2026 protects productive agricultural land from being converted, and enforcement has been real. Cheap land is often cheap because it is green zone and cannot carry a villa. We check the zone and the spatial-use clearance (KKPR) before anybody talks about price.
zoning.title.title: Title, chain and the banjar
zoning.title.text: The certificate chain is checked at the land office, the boundaries are surveyed, and the banjar is consulted before an offer goes in. Nominee arrangements — somebody’s name on your land — are exactly what the new rules target, so every structure we use is one you hold in your own right.
zoning.company.title: The company, in the right order
zoning.company.text: PT PMA first, spatial clearance next, land agreement last. That order is not paperwork pedantry: under the risk-based licensing regime (PP 28/2025) the online system will simply reject an application whose business classification, zone and building function do not agree with each other.
zoning.permit.title: Permit, and the certificate that follows it
zoning.permit.text: PBG cannot be issued without zoning clearance, and SLF follows completion. A villa with both, plus an NIB, can be listed and let. One without them cannot — which is precisely why a compliant property has become the more valuable one.
zoning.note: Regulation moves. Everything here reflects the position as we understand it in 2026 and is the starting point for a conversation with your notary, not a substitute for one. We do this work on every plot before you commit to anything.
after.title: The keys are the middle of this, not the end.
after.lead: Most of the relationship happens after you own it. Here is the whole loop, through to the money arriving in your account and, eventually, to selling it on.
after.keys.title: Handover and the first guests
after.keys.text: Photography, listings and pricing are prepared in the last eight weeks of construction, so the villa goes live within three weeks of handover rather than three months. You get the defects list, the warranties, and the manuals for everything in the building.
after.monthly.title: One statement, every month
after.monthly.text: What came in, what went out, what was transferred, and anything unusual — on one page, on the fifth, with the supplier invoices and the full booking ledger attached. Nothing is netted off without a line showing it.
after.money.title: Money in your account
after.money.text: The balance is transferred monthly to the account you nominate, in the currency you ask for. Indonesian tax on rental income (PB1 and company filings) is lodged by us, and the annual pack your accountant at home will want is prepared without you having to ask.
after.exit.title: And when you want out
after.exit.text: A leasehold can be assigned, and a villa with a clean permit trail and two years of published statements sells faster and higher than one without. We keep the file in a state that makes that possible, we will market it when the time comes, and we will tell you honestly what the remaining term is worth.
